contexts.text: (The antediluvians are covered with a misty rock.) AC 1266-1270:end. AC 1512. AC 1673:2. SE 3358. SE 4217.
The rock of Israel () = the Lord in predication to the goods of charity.
The rock out of which the waters gushed (.) = the Lord. AC 2702:13.

Swords of rocks () = the truths with which they were imbued, so that they could castigate and dispel filthy loves; for without the Knowledges of truth there is no purification. That a stone, or rock, = truths. References.
Rocky places () = truth which has no root in good.
Look unto the rock whence ye were hewn (); treating of the Lord... who as to Divine truth is called the rock.

Say to the mountains and rocks. Fall on us (); for the misty and pitch dark sphere which exhales from the evils and falsities of the infernals, appears like a mountain or rock, beneath which they are hidden. AC 8265:2.
The rock upon which the Church will be built () = the faith of charity.
The rock of the plain () = faith in which is no charity.
Hard rock = persuasion.
Their rock sold them (). Rock, in the supreme sense, = the Lord as to truth; in the representative, faith.
Shall horses run upon the rock? () = will the truth of faith be understood?
A stone cut out of the rock ()... = out of the truth of faith.
Zipporah took a rock () = quality shown... through truth.
Circumcision done with knives of rock = purification... through truths of faith. Explained.
He made them drink great abysses out of the rock () = truths of faith without defect; for a rock = faith from the Lord, thus the Lord as to faith.
A rock, in the Word, = faith.
I stand... upon the rock in Horeb () = the Lord as to the truths of faith; for a rock = faith, here, faith from the Lord, or the Lord as to faith; for the Lord says, I stand upon the rock.
That a rock = the Lord as to faith; and, relatively to man, the faith which is from the Lord. Illustrated.
A rock = the Lord as to the truth of faith, because by a rock is also meant a bulwark against falsities...
A rock = the Lord as to faith, and also the faith which is from the Lord, in the Lord's words to Peter... AC 9410:3.
When Jehovah is called a rock, there is meant the Lord as to faith. Illustrated.
As a rock = the Lord as to faith, and faith from the Lord, wonderful things were done upon a rock. Illustrated.
The hole of a rock () = what is obscure of faith. AC 10582, Explained.
Thou shalt smite the rock () = that they should urgently entreat the Lord, but from a humble heart.
The rock from which the waters went forth = the Lord as to faith.
The rocks were rent () = the dissipation of all things of faith; for a rock = the Lord as to faith, and hence the faith which is from the Lord.
Hidden in a hole of a rock near Euphrates () = where faith is in obscurity and becomes null through falsities from reasonings. (A hole of a rock = truth falsified. AC 9828:4.)
Round those in truths, and not from good, appear nothing but rocky places...

On the rocks (there) are those who are in faith... Hence it is that by rocks are signified those in the good of faith, and thence who are in the ultimate Heaven; and, in the abstract sense, that good, and that Heaven.
Thou shalt stand upon the rock () = a state of faith in God... Rock = faith.
That a rock = faith, is from the appearances (there): those who are in faith there dwell upon rocks ... The rocks there appear stony, but not the mountains.
The clefts of the rocks () = the derivative falsities of faith.
Those in the holes of the rocks () = those in faith, but not yet illustrated; thus those in what is obscure of faith. AE 405:17.

To dwell in the holes of a rock (; ) = in the falsities of faith. It treats of those who exalt themselves over others, believing that they are more learned than all others, when yet they are in falsities, and cannot see truths. These (there) dwell in holes of the rocks; and sometimes they project themselves forth upon the rocks, but are cast down again into their holes, and into caverns, which are beneath the rocks. Signified.
The spiritual Angels dwell upon rocks... But infernals beneath... the rocks.
The (Fourth) Earth in that part is very rocky, and only some valleys between the rocks are cultivated.
The Angels in the lowest parts of Heaven dwell in places which appear like rocks of stone saxis... It is from this that... rocks = faith.
[Swedenborg footnote 2.]. Rocks = the good and truth of faith. References.
Those who have been in the knowledge of doctrinal things... but have not applied anything to life, choose for themselves rocky places, and dwell among stone heaps...
(Overthrow of the rocks at the Last Judgment.) See Last Judgment. SE 4925. SE 4930. SE 5070. SE 5077. SE 5078. LJPost 134-137.
The seed upon the rocky places = Truth with those who care for the Truth but not for its own sake, thus not interiorly.
Hid themselves... in the rocks of the mountains () = that they were now... in the falsities of evil. AE 410.

Those who have pretended to be in the truths of faith, and yet were in falsities of evil, hide themselves in the rocks of the mountains. The entrances appear like... fissures... Illustrated. AE 410:2.
And said to... the rocks, Fall on us... () = confirmations... of falsity from evil... The rocks = falsities of faith. AE 411.
It was founded upon the rock () = upon the Lord as to Divine truth.
The Divine truth which is meant by the rock upon which the Lord would build His Church, is that which Peter then confessed: Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God. TCR 224:end.
Laid the foundation upon the rock (). The rock = the Lord as to the Divine truth of the Word. TCR 379.
Occurs.
They were let down through a rock... it was a hard rock, inclining downwards.
As it were Jesuits appear... they are let down deeper (in Hell) and covered over with a cloud, like a rock.
(A dream about two rocks.) Explained.
(Rocky places, in Hell.)
Those who dwell upon a certain rock...
When the whole rocks subside, and become valleys, it is good, and = those who suffer themselves to be regenerated.
(Nerez) was in a city upon a rock...
I was brought upon a rock, into a city there... it was like London. Described.
(Luther) betook himself upon a high rock.
(These infernals) were then on a rock, and could thus have communication with those round about...
The Genii... are separated from the Hells of Spirits by, as it were, a hard rock...
(G. Benzelstierna) was put beneath a rock; for there is a misty rock which goes over such...
Those in faith from charity are described by the house built on the rock.
The inhabitants of the rock () = the good of faith in them.
The rocks () = their faith.
The rock = the Lord.
To suck oil out of the flint of a rock () = to be imbued with good through the truths of faith.
The rocks which are overturned () = the truths of faith, because those in faith, who do good from obedience, although not from charity, (there) dwell upon rocks.
The rock of Israel = the Lord as to Divine truth in the Church. AE 411:8.
Rocky places = historical faith, which faith is the faith of another in one's self.

Regeneration through truths from good, is signified by, He turned the rock into a pool of waters, and the flint into a fountain of waters (). The rock = the natural man as to truth before reformation; and the flint, as to good.
Rocks = where are truths of faith, here, falsities of evil. AE 410.
The Hells are under the mountains, and in the rocks.
For their Hells appear as caves in the rocks, and the entrances as the rents of rocks, and fissures of crags.
Rocks = falsities of faith and of doctrine.
Rocks = truth from spiritual good, and the truth and good of faith: and, in the opposite, what is false of faith. (Fully illustrated.)

Rocks and crags appear (there), and upon them dwell those who are in truths from spiritual good, and who are in the truth and good of faith... The mountains and hills are of soil, but the rocks and crags are of stone; for... stone corresponds to the truth of faith... Those in falsities of faith dwell within the rocks in the caverns there.
That a rock = truth from good, and the truth of faith, and, in the supreme sense, the Lord as to these. Illustrated.
That a rock = the Lord as to Divine truth. Illustrated.
For a rock, in the Word, = the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord; and therefore Moses and Aaron were commanded to speak to the rock.
Rock, in these passages, = the Lord as to Divine truth, or what is the same. Divine truth from the Lord.

Look unto the rock whence ye were hewn () = the Lord as to Divine truth... To be hewn out of the rock = to be regenerated from Divine truths ... for stones which are hewn out of a rock = truths from the Lord. AE 721:11.

That they have natural good and spiritual good through the Divine truth from the Lord, is signified by, He made them suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flint of the rock... The rock = external Divine truth from the Lord which is for the natural man; and the flint of the rock = internal Divine truth from the Lord which is for the spiritual man... The rock which begat thee hast thou given to forgetfulness = that the Lord, and hence the Divine truth, were rejected... That they were altogether deprived of truth and good, is signified by, Their rock has sold them... That they would be in falsity from evil, is signified by, Their rock is not as our rock.
In these passages, by rock is meant the Divine truth from the Lord, and the Lord Himself.

The house founded upon the rock = the Church and the men of the Church who have founded their doctrine and life upon the Divine truth which is from the Lord, thus upon those things which are in the Word, consequently who are in truths from good from the Lord. Explained.

Peter represented the Divine truth from the Lord in the Church, and therefore he was called Petra, and it is said, Thou art Petra, upon this Petra I will build My Church, (that is), upon the Divine truth from the Lord, or, what is the same, upon truths from good, for upon these the Church is built. That Peter might represent this in the Church, he was called Petra, (or a Rock) as is evident from... Thou shalt be called Kephas, which is, by interpretation, a Rock ()... AE 820:2. AE 820:4.
In the opposite sense, a rock = the infernal falsity which is confided in. Illustrated.

I have seen rocks which consisted of heaped up stones, and not of any verdure clad fields, as elsewhere are upon the rocks: upon them were Spirits who had been in faith separated from charity... This is meant by the dryness of the rock. Illustrated. When there is no soil upon the rocks, and the rocks are dry, or consist of mere heaps of stones, it is an indication that there is not any good, and, where there is no good, there is mere falsity.

Most who have light from the Moon there, dwell upon rocks. The spiritual natural dwell upon rocks which are covered on the surface with soil, whence are fields, groves, etc., but not such as are upon the mountains and hills... But the merely natural are not at this day upon rocks, but in rocks in caverns; and those in falsities from evil dwell among heaps of detached rocks there.
Damnation through falsities, is signified by, I will roll thee down from the rocks ().
Dwell in the rock () = in falsities and the doctrine thereof.
Is not My word... like a hammer that scattereth the rock () = (like) the truth of faith (which scatters) falsity in the whole complex.

The rocks shall be overturned before Him () = (the perishing of falsities from evils at the Last Judgment). Moreover the rocks upon which are they who are in principles of falsity and thence in falsities of every kind, are visibly overturned, and those on them are thus cast down into Hell.
Under the peaks of the rocks () = falsities... from the Sensuous in which the lumen is ultimate natural; for they who are in this lumen only, stand under steep rocks, and do not see any truth.
Blessed shall he be that... scattereth thine infants to the rock () = nascent falsities destroyed (by) the reigning falsity of evil.
The snow of Lebanon from the rock () = the truths of the Church from the Word.
The rock of the plain () = the falsity of doctrine (from the ultimates of the Word).
Enter into the rock () = into falsity.

As those in falsities dwell in rocks, it is said, Let them be cast down through places of the rock (), by which is signified that they are let into their falsities, and dwell in Hells which correspond to their falsities.

Those who are in the faith of the doctrinals of their own Church, and in some charity, dwell upon rocks where there are fields upon which are some bushes and some trees, and grassy places; but those in faith alone as to doctrine and life, and thence in falsities of faith and evils of life, dwell within the rocks, in caverns and cells there.
This signification of rock is from the correspondence which has been stated. But the signification of rock from its hardness, is contained in the following passages. Illustrated.

The reason hardness is expressed by a rock, is from the correspondence of a rock with truth from good, for all power is in truth from good; but, when truth acts against falsity from evil, then good is blunted, and the remaining truth acts hardly. Illustrated.
The rock at which that temptation took place () = the Lord, and the waters thence, Divine truths. AE 518:21. Illustrated.
The Lord, from the Divine truth which proceeds from Him, is called the rock of Israel. AE 701:8.
The rock upon which the wise man built his house, = the Lord as to Divine truth, or the Divine truth received in soul and heart, that is, in faith and love.
He has set my feet upon a rock () = on the truth of doctrine from the Word; and, in the supreme sense, the Lord as to Divine truth.
He shall exalt me upon a rock () = to instruct in interior truths.
